title: Mesh study: slanted-sidewall TFLN rib (em_modes n_eff)
description:
S7.8 mesh study reference problem: the TFLN rib of examples/em/tfln_rib_waveguide_modes.json (600 nm x-cut film, 300 nm etch, 1.2 um top, 60 degree sidewalls) at 1550 nm, mode_analysis, quasi-TE0 n_eff. No closed form: the analysis takes a Richardson extrapolation of the finest uniform runs as reference.
Mesh variants (set by open_sol.mesh_study.accuracy): uniform dx_fine; graded_box = base dx_base with the rib bounding box refined to dx_fine (rows across the whole width, so the slab is fine too); anisotropic = base dx_base, S7.1 axis bands: y rows over the film, x columns over the sidewall only. snap_film / snap_slab put cell edges on the film interfaces and make the first cell dx_fine wide, so the x min mirror plane (inner face of the first cell) stays at x_mirror = dx_fine.

parameters.name: n_o
parameters.description: ordinary index of LN at 1550 nm

parameters.name: n_e
parameters.description: extraordinary index of LN at 1550 nm

parameters.name: sidewall_deg
parameters.description: sidewall angle to the substrate plane in degrees

parameters.name: t_top
parameters.description: top cladding above the film top

parameters.name: w_window
parameters.description: lateral window from the mirror plane to the x max PML

parameters.name: dx_fine
parameters.description: finest cell size (uniform dx; first cell = mirror plane offset)

parameters.name: dx_base
parameters.description: base cell size of the graded variants

parameters.name: ref_margin
parameters.description: refinement margin around the rib / bands

parameters.name: x_mirror
parameters.description: rib centre = x min mirror plane (inner face of the first cell)
